name: Rongo Rongo
description: (Tag:divination)(Tag:earth)(Tag:tool)Dubbed "Complete Book of the World", Rongo Rongo is a book Teigu containing a detailed map and encyclopedia of your entire world with locations plus future natural disasters like earthquakes, tsunamis, storms, and rains. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
